events.title: Storm damage to a family business
events.body: Wind and rain have damaged {property}. Its condition has fallen and production will suffer until repairs are made.

choices.label: Pay for proper repairs
choices.result: The damaged property is restored; the payment comes from the shared purse.

choices.label: Make a temporary patch
choices.result: The family restores part of the damage, but the shared work adds pressure.

choices.label: Leave it for now
choices.result: No money is spent. The damage continues to reduce the property's output.

events.title: Flooded farm buildings
events.body: Water has entered {property}, damaging the farm buildings. The farm's condition and future sales are reduced.

choices.label: Drain and repair the buildings
choices.result: The damage is repaired at the family's expense.

choices.label: Clear the worst damage together
choices.result: The patch helps, while the household shoulders the extra effort.

choices.label: Wait for funds
choices.result: The damaged farm continues with reduced output.
